company.name: Revomon
company.shortDescription: Revomon is a mobile monster taming gaming company that offers VR experiences such as grabbing, throwing, and shooting games.
company.description:
Revomon is an innovative online role-playing game (RPG) that merges immersive virtual reality gameplay with blockchain-powered NFTs to create a truly interactive Web3 gaming metaverse. Available across VR platforms and Android mobile devices, Revomon delivers a cross-platform experience where players can explore expansive virtual worlds, socialize with others, and hunt for wild Revomon creatures in real time.

Blending elements reminiscent of Axie Infinity and Pokémon GO, Revomon introduces players to a fully immersive VR environment where gameplay goes beyond traditional RPG mechanics. Users can physically interact with the game through VR actions such as grabbing, throwing, shooting, and free movement, creating a more engaging and realistic gaming experience.

At the core of Revomon is blockchain technology, which enables true digital ownership through NFTs. Players can own, collect, trade, and monetize in-game assets, giving real-world value to virtual items and achievements. By combining VR immersion, mobile accessibility, and decentralized ownership, Revomon is building a player-driven metaverse where gaming, community, and digital economies seamlessly converge.
